reasoning_content: pnpm 12 uses @pnpm/exe which needs libatomic.so.1. Install libatomic1. Also the app pnpm-workspace sets use-node-version = 24.16.0, so pnpm will download node 24.16.0. Let's install libatomic1.

action.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y libatomic1 2>&1 | tail -3; ldconfig -p | grep libatomic
